phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Computing Foundations — Build hardware/software foundations, explore computer engineering careers.

milestones.label: Explore computer engineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on computer engineering applications in embedded systems, VLSI design, IoT, robotics, and hardware-software co-design.

milestones.label: Master programming fundamentals
milestones.description: Object-oriented programming in C/C++ with emphasis on systems-level programming, memory management, and hardware interfacing concepts relevant to computer engineering.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and integration. Mathematical foundation for circuit analysis, signal processing, and computer architecture.

milestones.label: Join IEEE student branch or robotics club
milestones.description: Join the IEEE student branch, NSBE, robotics club, or ACM chapter. Participate in hardware projects, maker spaces, and embedded systems workshops.

milestones.label: Study physics foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Mechanics, waves, and introduction to electromagnetism. Foundation for circuit analysis, electromagnetics, and semiconductor physics.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Digital Systems & Circuit Design — Master digital logic, circuit analysis, and microprocessor architecture.

milestones.label: Master digital logic design
milestones.description: Boolean algebra, combinational and sequential logic, finite state machines, and FPGA implementation. Students design and verify digital circuits using Verilog/VHDL.

milestones.label: Master circuit analysis fundamentals
milestones.description: DC and AC circuit analysis, Kirchhoff's laws, Thevenin/Norton equivalents, frequency response, and op-amp circuits. Foundation for analog and mixed-signal design.

milestones.label: Build an embedded systems project
milestones.description: Participate in IEEE or maker club projects building embedded systems with Arduino or Raspberry Pi. Develop hands-on skills in hardware prototyping and embedded programming.

milestones.label: Study microprocessor architecture and assembly
milestones.description: Microprocessor architecture, instruction sets, assembly language programming, and interfacing with peripherals. Students program ARM-based microcontrollers for real-time applications.

milestones.label: Master data structures for hardware-software systems
milestones.description: Data structures and algorithms with emphasis on memory-efficient implementations for embedded and resource-constrained systems.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Computer Systems & Professional Experience — Master computer architecture, VLSI, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master computer architecture
milestones.description: Pipelining, cache design, multicore processors, memory hierarchy, and parallel computing architectures. Students design and simulate CPU components using hardware description languages.

milestones.label: Study VLSI and integrated circuit design
milestones.description: CMOS circuit design, layout, simulation, and verification. Students design custom digital circuits and complete the layout-to-GDS flow using industry EDA tools (Cadence, Synopsys).

milestones.label: Present research at IEEE conference or symposium
milestones.description: Present undergraduate research or design project at an IEEE conference, department symposium, or undergraduate research event. Network with industry professionals and graduate researchers.

milestones.label: Complete summer computer engineering internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a semiconductor company, tech firm, or embedded systems company. Apply hardware design and systems programming skills professionally.

milestones.label: Study embedded systems and IoT
milestones.description: Real-time operating systems, sensor interfacing, wireless communication, and IoT architecture. Students design and deploy embedded IoT systems with cloud connectivity.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, prepare for industry, and launch computer engineering career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long hardware-software co-design project addressing a real engineering challenge. Teams design, prototype, test, and demonstrate an embedded or digital system.

milestones.label: Prepare for FE exam and technical interviews
milestones.description: Prepare for the NCEES FE exam and tech industry interviews. Practice LeetCode problems, system design questions, and hardware design interviews for semiconductor and tech companies.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and IEEE chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in computer engineering, lead IEEE chapter activities, and organize hardware workshops, tech talks, and career panels.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, hardware design portfolio, GitHub projects, FE exam status, and documented professional network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Computer Engineering Exit Assessment demonstrating ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or certification achievements.
